# Aashir Javed

I build AI agents for regulated finance. Senior software engineer in London, currently employed at MoonPay on the identity team. I build agent harnesses (tools, memory, evals, guardrails) and the KYC, risk and payment systems they run alongside. Available for advisory and build work with private credit, DeFi and fintech teams.

## What I do

- Onboarding and compliance controls: KYC and KYB with beneficial owner mapping, accredited investor and qualified purchaser gating, document verification, sanctions and PEP screening, wallet allowlisting, ongoing monitoring, auditable case files.
- Risk, rules and authorisation: eligibility and limit engines, jurisdiction tiering, authentication and authorisation boundaries, transfer restrictions and identity registries for restricted tokens.
- AI in operations: document ingestion, underwriting preparation, covenant and portfolio monitoring agents, evaluation suites, private models when data cannot leave. The system prepares the file. A person makes the call.

## Engagement

- Diagnostic call: 45 minutes, no charge.
- Diligence sprint: two weeks, fixed fee, written go or no go view and build plan.
- Fractional lead: one to three days a week, monthly.
